text:
Riley (People Ops): dropping a tiny '90s review' cheatsheet for fast self-reviews + manager notes. designed for 10-15m syncs. paste as-is.

Riley (People Ops): SELF-REVIEW (3 bullets, 90s)
1) Top outcome + metric (1 line).
2) Biggest blocker + how you mitigated (1 line).
3) One ask for manager (hiring, time, intro) (1 line).

Riley (People Ops): MANAGER STARTER (60s)
- Manager one-liner: "Highlight: X (evidence link). Area: Y (clear next step)."
- Followup question: "What would help you unblocked this next sprint?"

Eli (Eng Manager): cool. add a quick calibration hint?

Riley (People Ops): CALIBRATION NOTE (for managers)
- Use the same language across reports: outcome, evidence, impact. Avoid vague praise without metric.

Zara (IC): can we get a template for "didn't meet" without it sounding punitive?

Riley (People Ops): MISSED GOAL TONE (short)
- "Outcome not met due to X; here we shipped partial mitigation and set date for remaining work. Next ask: help with hiring/priority"

Anika (Hiring): also include hiring signal template pls

Riley (People Ops): HIRING SIGNAL (one line)
- "Hiring suggestion: 1 Staff SWE to finish autoscaler (reason: single owner causing rollout delays)."

Chris (People Ops): pinned to #people-ops-templates and scheduled a reminder-bot template: "Please post your 3 bullets 48h before review"

Bot (reminder-bot): Reminder scheduled for 1797420000 (48h).

Maya (Mngr): using this next round. thanks ":thumbsup:"

Riley (People Ops): happy to make role-specific variants (PM, Data, Infra). ping for copies.
